items.source: Build the WebClient instance.
items.translation: 构建 `WebClient` 实例。

items.source: Provides access to every defaultHeader(String, String...) declared so far with the possibility to add, replace, or remove.
items.translation: 提供对迄今为止声明的每个defaultHeader(String, String...)的访问权限，并支持添加、替换或删除。

items.source: this builder
items.translation: 此构建器

items.source: This is an alternative to, and effectively overrides clientConnector(ClientHttpConnector), and exchangeStrategies(ExchangeStrategies).
items.translation: 这是 `clientConnector(ClientHttpConnector)` 和 `exchangeStrategies(ExchangeStrategies)` 的替代方案，并实际上覆盖了它们。

items.source: Note: this method is mutually exclusive with uriBuilderFactory(UriBuilderFactory). If both are used, the baseUrl value provided here will be ignored.
items.translation: 注意：此方法与uriBuilderFactory(UriBuilderFactory)互斥。如果同时使用两者，此处提供的 baseUrl 值将被忽略。

items.source: Note: this method is mutually exclusive with uriBuilderFactory(UriBuilderFactory). If both are used, the defaultUriVariables value provided here will be ignored.
items.translation: 注意：此方法与 uriBuilderFactory(UriBuilderFactory) 互斥。如果同时使用两者，此处提供的 defaultUriVariables 值将被忽略。

items.source: ApiVersionInserter exposes shortcut methods for several built-in inserter implementation types. See the class-level Javadoc of ApiVersionInserter for a list of choices.
items.translation: ApiVersionInserter 为几种内置的插入器实现类型提供了快捷方法。有关选项列表，请参阅 ApiVersionInserter 的类级别 Javadoc。

items.source: By default this is set to ReactorClientHttpConnector.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此值设置为 ReactorClientHttpConnector。

items.source: By default this is set to ExchangeStrategies.withDefaults().
items.translation: 默认情况下，此值设置为ExchangeStrategies.withDefaults()。

items.source: The default status handlers are not applied to exchangeTo*() methods, as those variants have direct access to the client response.
items.translation: 默认状态处理器不适用于 `exchangeTo*()` 方法，因为这些变体可以直接访问客户端响应。

items.source:
Provide a pre-configured UriBuilderFactory instance. This is an alternative to, and effectively overrides the following shortcut properties:
  • baseUrl(String)
  • defaultUriVariables(Map).
items.translation:
提供一个预配置的UriBuilderFactory实例。这是以下快捷属性的替代方案，并实际上覆盖了它们：
  • baseUrl(String)
  • defaultUriVariables(Map)。

items.source: Provide an ExchangeFunction pre-configured with ClientHttpConnector and ExchangeStrategies.
items.translation: 提供一个已配置了ClientHttpConnector和ExchangeStrategies的ExchangeFunction。

items.source: Configure an ApiVersionInserter to abstract how an API version specified via WebClient.RequestHeadersSpec.apiVersion(Object) is inserted into the request.
items.translation: 配置一个ApiVersionInserter，以抽象通过WebClient.RequestHeadersSpec.apiVersion(Object)指定的 API 版本如何插入到请求中。

items.source: Configure the codecs for the WebClient in the underlying ExchangeStrategies.
items.translation: 配置 `WebClient` 的底层 ExchangeStrategies 中的编解码器。

items.source: Provide an ObservationConvention to use for collecting metadata for the request observation. Will use DefaultClientRequestObservationConvention if none provided.
items.translation: 提供用于收集请求观察元数据的ObservationConvention。如果未提供，将使用DefaultClientRequestObservationConvention。

items.source: Configure the ClientHttpConnector to use.
items.translation: 配置要使用的ClientHttpConnector。

items.source: Provides access to every defaultCookie(String, String...) declared so far with the possibility to add, replace, or remove.
items.translation: 提供对迄今为止声明的每个defaultCookie(String, String...)的访问权限，并支持添加、替换或删除。

items.source: Register a default status handler to apply to every response.
items.translation: 注册一个默认的 状态处理器，以应用于每个响应。

items.source: Configure the ExchangeStrategies to use.
items.translation: 配置要使用的ExchangeStrategies。

items.source: Provide a pre-configured UriBuilderFactory instance.
items.translation: 提供一个预配置的UriBuilderFactory实例。

items.source: Clone this WebClient.Builder.
items.translation: 克隆此WebClient.Builder。

items.source: Provide an ObservationRegistry to use for recording observations for HTTP client calls.
items.translation: 提供用于记录 HTTP 客户端调用观测的ObservationRegistry。

items.source:
Global option to specify an API version to add to every request,
if not already set.
items.translation: 全局选项，用于指定要添加到每个请求中的 API 版本（如果尚未设置）。

items.source:
Global option to specify a cookie to be added to every request,
if the request does not already contain such a cookie.
items.translation: 全局选项，用于指定一个要添加到每个请求中的 Cookie；如果该请求尚未包含此类 Cookie。

items.source:
Global option to specify a header to be added to every request,
if the request does not already contain such a header.
items.translation: 全局选项，用于指定要添加到每个请求的标头（如果该请求尚未包含此类标头）。

items.source: Provide a consumer to customize every request being built.
items.translation: 提供一个消费者以自定义正在构建的每个请求。

items.source: Add the given filter to the end of the filter chain.
items.translation: 将给定的过滤器添加到过滤器链的末尾。

items.source:
Manipulate the filters with the given consumer. The list provided to
the consumer is "live", so that the consumer can be used to remove
filters, change ordering, etc.
items.translation: 使用给定的消费者操作过滤器。提供给消费者的列表是“实时”的，因此该消费者可用于移除过滤器、更改排序等。

items.source: exceptionFunction - to map the response to an error signal
items.translation: exceptionFunction - 将响应映射到错误信号

items.source: exchangeFunction - the exchange function to use
items.translation: exchangeFunction - 要使用的交换函数

items.source: For most cases, prefer using codecs(Consumer) which allows customizing the codecs in the ExchangeStrategies rather than replace them. That ensures multiple parties can contribute to codecs configuration.
items.translation: 对于大多数情况，建议使用codecs(Consumer)来自定义ExchangeStrategies中的编解码器，而不是替换它们。这样可以确保多个方都能为编解码器配置做出贡献。

items.source: The DefaultUriBuilderFactory is used to prepare the URL for every request with the given base URL, unless the URL request for a given URL is absolute in which case the base URL is ignored.
items.translation: `DefaultUriBuilderFactory` 用于为每个请求准备带有给定基本 URL 的 URL，除非针对给定 URL 的 URL 请求是绝对的，在这种情况下将忽略基本 URL。

items.source: This can be useful for applying pre-packaged customizations.
items.translation: 这可用于应用预打包的自定义配置。

items.source: A mutable builder for creating a WebClient.
items.translation: 用于创建WebClient的可变构建器。

items.source: Configure default URL variable values to use when expanding URI templates with a Map.
items.translation: 配置默认 URL 变量值，以便在使用 Map 扩展 URI 模板时使用。

items.source: Apply the given Consumer to this builder instance.
items.translation: 应用给定的Consumer到此构建器实例。

items.source: Provide an ObservationConvention to use for collecting metadata for the request observation.
items.translation: 提供用于收集请求观察元数据的ObservationConvention。

items.source: Configure a base URL for requests.
items.translation: 为请求配置基础 URL。

items.source: Manipulate the filters with the given consumer.
items.translation: 使用给定的 Consumer 操纵过滤器。

items.source: uriBuilderFactory - the URI builder factory to use
items.translation: uriBuilderFactory - 要使用的 URI 构建器工厂

items.source: header - the header name
items.translation: header - 标头名称

items.source: values - the header values
items.translation: values - 标头值

items.source: headersConsumer - the consumer
items.translation: headersConsumer - 消费者

items.source: cookie - the cookie name
items.translation: cookie - Cookie 名称

items.source: values - the cookie values
items.translation: values - Cookie 值

items.source: cookiesConsumer - a function that consumes the cookies map
items.translation: cookiesConsumer - 一个消费 cookies 映射的函数

items.source: version - the version to use
items.translation: version - 要使用的版本

items.source: apiVersionInserter - the inserter to use
items.translation: apiVersionInserter - 要使用的插入器

items.source: defaultRequest - the consumer to use for modifying requests
items.translation: defaultRequest - 用于修改请求的消费者

items.source: statusPredicate - to match responses with
items.translation: statusPredicate - 用于匹配响应

items.source: filter - the filter to be added to the chain
items.translation: filter - 要添加到链中的过滤器

items.source: filtersConsumer - a function that consumes the filter list
items.translation: filtersConsumer - 一个消费过滤器列表的函数

items.source: connector - the connector to use
items.translation: connector - 要使用的连接器

items.source: configurer - the configurer to apply
items.translation: configurer - 要应用的配置器

items.source: strategies - the strategies to use
items.translation: strategies - 要使用的策略

items.source: observationRegistry - the observation registry to use
items.translation: observationRegistry - 要使用的观察注册表

items.source: observationConvention - the observation convention to use
items.translation: observationConvention - 要使用的观测约定

items.source: builderConsumer - the consumer to apply
items.translation: builderConsumer - 要应用的消费者

items.source: Rossen Stoyanchev, Arjen Poutsma, Sebastien Deleuze, Brian Clozel
items.translation: Rossen Stoyanchev, Arjen Poutsma, Sebastien Deleuze, Brian Clozel
